articles.title: 'Smashed head': Father, brother kill woman over viral video with male friend
articles.summary: A disturbing case emerged where a woman was allegedly murdered by her father and brother in a supposed act of family honour. The crime was triggered by a viral video showcasing her with a male acquaintance.

Million-dollar question: OpenAI claims to have an answer to 90-year old maths problem
articles.summary: OpenAI has revealed that its advanced AI model has found a solution to a complex math problem that has persisted for 90 years. This monumental task in fluid dynamics was accomplished in just 88 hours, employing nearly ten thousand AI agents during the process.

articles.title: Why shouldn’t National Sports Governance Act apply to BCCI, asks Supreme Court
articles.summary: If the BCCI and state cricket associations agree to be covered under the NSG Act and the Rules framed thereunder, then all the litigation pending before the SC relating to the functioning and management of cricket bodies would get transferred to the sports tribunal..

articles.title: Toxic air after 9/11: Mamdani releases documents showing how New Yorkers were misled
articles.summary: In a significant move, New York City disclosed withheld documents on air quality after 9/11, suggesting that officials may have misrepresented the dangers present post-collapse of the Twin Towers. A memo warned of potential lawsuits for toxic exposure and city liability concerns.

articles.title: Roman cemetery dig reveals Stone Age man buried with 2 skulls, 42 teeth and an axe
articles.summary: In a startling archaeological find, researchers uncovered a burial site dating back to the Stone Age, predating nearby Roman graves by thousands of years. The grave contained a battle axe, striking amber beads, and a unique necklace fashioned from the teeth of 42 animals.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Selena's LA mansion SOLD for USD 5.4 Mn: PICS
articles.summary: Selena Gomez has sold her Encino mansion for USD 5.4 million. This property was purchased in 2020 from Tom Petty's estate.

articles.title: ‘James Bond’ screenwriter Steven Knight talks about working on the film’s script
articles.summary: Screenwriter Steven Knight shared that crafting the new James Bond script has been a more fluid experience with an actor already chosen. He emphasized the importance of developing the character rather than focusing solely on the actor.

articles.title: Rajkiran moves Madras HC over producer’s complaint
articles.summary: In a recent legal maneuver, veteran actor Rajkiran sought anticipatory bail from the Madras High Court against allegations from a producer regarding an unpaid film advance of Rs 40 lakh. Rajkiran contends that the matter is civil, emphasizing he has already returned part of the advance after consultations with the Producers' Council.

articles.title: Did 'Dorothy' composer Ilaiyaraaja insult Karthik Subbaraj?
articles.summary: Music composer Ilaiyaraaja has stirred up conversations among fans with his recent comments about new talent. He articulated his preference for collaborating with emerging filmmakers like Karthik Subbaraj, describing them as 'empty vessels.' This sparked a mixed response, with some fans labeling his remarks as arrogant while others offered their admiration.
